_doc: backend applies to every config (OpenArc A/B/C and baseline D) of every run; a run's own `backend` overrides it field by field. provider: "ollama" (baseUrl = Ollama origin, native /api/chat) or "openai" (baseUrl = OpenAI-compatible base ending in /v1, e.g. llama-server). Both arms go through run.mjs's token-counting proxy to the same server. `openarc` is merged verbatim into OpenArc's backend block (preset, structuredOutput, think, ...). `info` is copied into every results row; fill it from the server you actually run. Thinking must be off server-side for openai backends: OpenArc's openai provider sends no thinking switch, so the baseline sends none either.

memory._why: a persistent llama-server keeps its weights resident, so MemAvailable may sit under 6 GB between tasks; lower minStartGb deliberately if so (Ollama-only runs unload instead)

disabledRuns._why: 14B+ does not fit this machine (15 GB RAM, 8 GB VRAM). Move into `runs` on a bigger box.
API slot: move into `runs` and export OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Tokens come from the response's `usage`.
